notes.title: HIGHCLEAR VR Patch 1.0.2 - Select Difficulty + Teleport
notes.notes:
New additions
Added 'SET UP' window.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29293332/6146152095d79409d5b2be33ff8da1f9791e2edc.png

Added Teleport to the Movement mode.
Adjustable volume.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29293332/a07ec9897917da021971156784d78867c29555a3.png

You can choose the difficulty level.
Added difficulty score.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29293332/a9bac0a7362e73c6acd33137536d411ca9ac8cb0.png

Difficulty angle / force correction is entered.
You can check the difficulty level in the game.


Modifications
Improved AI performance.
Fixed the power to hit the shuttlecock.
We eliminated the phenomenon that the audience overlaps the UI.


If you find new bugs in the game or want to improve it, 
please comment on discussion or here.

Thank you.


FIVESTARGAMES
